notes.text:
## Update
- Added Power Ups to the game mechanic
- Added an Autostart option in the settings
- Changed a bit the rules so that Relics can be changed as Items or  not.
- Changed that Goals now can be made [ Old issue was that by defeating Cortex even with Goal 100% it triggered ]
## What works:

- Collecting checks via Crystals, Gems, and Relics.

- Checks completed via Regular Exits and Bosses.

- N. Cortex is defeatable and you can finish the game in the normal goal also 100% and 105%.

## What is NOT working / Not implemented yet:


- Several options from the .apworld configuration are not functional yet (specifically Gimmicks, DeadLink, and Traps are currently unavailable).

## Known Issues & What needs to be tested:

- The Relics are in the options no longer an item but sadly checks that will be fixed!

- Wumpa Fruit Bundle is in some Levels only like Gem and Relics you only Wumpa Fruit Bundles

## Need to do
- Adding that you don't need to go into the Level again to collect the Item
- Adding auto connect

- Need to editing more on the rules to change the Wumpa Fruit Bundle problem

Finding a way to implement the Gimmiksand over stuff like the Traps and DeathLink

Have fun testing and helping out!

And special thanks for the people who tried version every versions yet
